describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its entire body except for the back is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur with lighter tan on the muzzle, chest and belly. The back and shoulders are covered by a large, glossy, dark brown domed shell that looks hard and smooth with reflective highlights. The head is broad and bear-like with a single curved black horn on the nose, and the feet are large clawed paws. The overall form combines a furry mammal body with a hard beetle-like carapace on top.

describe.description: A large four-legged furry mammal standing in profile facing right. The body, head, ears, legs and paws are those of a brown bear with thick shaggy dark brown fur, lighter tan on the muzzle, chest and belly. On the nose is a single long curved black horn pointing upward. Covering the entire back from behind the head to the rump is a large glossy dark brown domed shell with two main sections and a segmented lower rim, like a beetle carapace. The animal stands on four thick legs with clawed paws. No tail or wings are visible.
